rate.description: Amount of messages for the time.

window.description: Amount of intervals to calculate average over.

float_key.description: This parameter is for a float source.

int_key.description: This parameter is for an integer source.

str_key.description: This parameter is for a string source.

uint_key.description: This parameter is for an unsigned integer source.

accessible_paths.description: Specify the allowlist of paths to be able to access paths from Wasm programs.

event_format.description: Define event format to interact with Wasm programs: msgpack or json.

function_name.description: Wasm function name that will be triggered to do filtering.

wasm_heap_size.description: Size of the heap size of Wasm execution.

wasm_path.description: Path to the built Wasm program that will be used.

wasm_stack_size.description: Size of the stack size of Wasm execution.

delete.description: Delete operation expressed as a label key.

hash.description: Hash operation expressed as a label key.

action.description: Whether matching metrics are included or excluded.

context.description: Matching context.

metric_name.description: Metric name or regex used by the match operation.

label.description: Label key/value pair used by delete_label_value matching.

drop_first.description: Compatibility option for first-sample handling when initial_value is unset.

drop_on_reset.description: Drop a sample when a reset is detected.

initial_value.description: How the first sample for a new series is handled.

max_series.description: Maximum number of series tracked in memory.

max_staleness.description: How long to retain per-series state.

window_size.description: Number of samples kept in the sliding window.

min_points.description: Minimum number of samples required before analysis runs.

threshold.description: Distance threshold quantile or 0 for automatic scan.

action.description: Content modifier action to perform.

context.description: Trace context where the modification is applied.

pattern.description: Regular expression used by the extract action.

converted_type.description: Target type used by the convert action.

sampling_settings.description: Sampling settings object, such as percentage or decision_wait.
